name: Akiba Mayumi
source:
[url=/c98452]Asuka[/url]'s friend and schoolmate, who is in love with [url=/c98451]Souji[/url]. She is an otaku who enjoys reading BL manga. She gets jealous of the close relationship between Souji and [url=/c98454]Akira[/url], a feminine looking boy who goes to the same Kendo club as him. 

[Translated from [url=https://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E3%82%B3%E3%83%BB%E3%82%B3%E3%83%BB%E3%83%AD%E2%80%A6]Wikipedia[/url].]
